search.query: `github_webhooks` eventtype="GitHub::VulnerabilityAlert" | eval action='action', repository=if(isnotnull('repository.name'),'repository.name','unknown'), severity=coalesce('alert.severity','alert.security_vulnerability.severity','none'), create_time=if(isnotnull('alert.created_at'),'alert.created_at','unknown'), received_time='_time', alert_url=coalesce('alert.html_url','alert.external_reference','unknown'), eventtype='eventtype', created=strptime(create_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%Z"), resolved_at=case('alert.dismissed_at' != "null", 'alert.dismissed_at', isnotnull('alert.fixed_at'), 'alert.fixed_at', isnotnull('alert.resolved_at'),'alert.resolved_at', isnotnull('alert.auto_dismissed_at'), 'alert.auto_dismissed_at', 1=1, _time), duration = toString(round(strptime(resolved_at, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S") - strptime(create_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"))), duration_str=tostring(avg(duration), "duration")

| search severity=$severity_label$ repository=$repoTkn$ action IN("resolve","fixed") | eval age = avg(duration) | appendpipe [ stats avg(age) as totalTime ] | eval mttr = toString(round(totalTime), "duration"), clean_mttr = replace (mttr , "\+" , " days, ") | stats max(clean_mttr)
| search severity=$severity_label$ repository=$repoTkn$ action IN("create","created","reopened","auto_reopened","reintroduced") | stats count
| search severity=$severity_label$ repository=$repoTkn$ action IN("resolve","fixed") | stats count
| search severity=$severity_label$ repository=$repoTkn$ action IN("dismiss","dismissed","auto_dismissed") | stats count

| search severity=$severity_label$ repository=$repoTkn$ action IN("create","created","reopened","auto_reopened","reintroduced","resolve","fixed","dismiss","dismissed","auto_dismissed") | timechart count(_raw) by action | eval Found=coalesce(create,0)+coalesce(created,0)+coalesce(reopened,0)+coalesce(auto_reopened,0)+coalesce(reintroduced,0) | eval Fixed=coalesce(resolve,0)+coalesce(fixed,0) | eval Dismissed=coalesce(dismiss,0)+coalesce(dismissed,0)+coalesce(auto_dismissed,0) | accum Found | accum Fixed | accum Dismissed | fields _time, Found, Fixed, Dismissed
| search severity=$severity_label$ repository=$repoTkn$ action IN("create","created","reopened","auto_reopened","reintroduced") | chart count by repository
| search severity=$severity_label$ repository=$repoTkn$ action IN("create","created","reopened","auto_reopened","reintroduced") | timechart count(_raw) by severity

| search action IN("resolve","fixed","dismiss","dismissed","auto_dismissed") repository=$repoTkn$ severity=$severity_label$ | table action, repository, severity, alert_url,duration_str | rename action AS "Action", repository AS "Repository" duration_str AS "Time to Resolution",severity AS "Severity", alert_url AS "Alert URL" | sort -"Time to Resolution"
